about_the_game:
The darkness hides everything… but sometimes seeing makes the unknown even scarier. You can’t take your eyes off the screen because maybe, even for a moment, you might notice something moving in the darkness. But be careful… Some things aren’t just being watched, they’re watching you. The light may feel safe, but the shadows always hide more. Make a choice… Which is scarier, to stay in the dark or to see what’s coming?




It's strange how quiet it is. A person should feel comfortable even in an empty pool. But the restlessness inside him doesn't stop. It's like you're not alone in this emptiness.



The same sound with every step. The same light. The same wall.

But something is different. Something might be watching you.



The waves of water are the only thing that breaks the silence inside.

But there is still something strange, maybe something is waiting for you in this water.



There is no light at the end of the tunnel, only more darkness.

It is hard to take a step, but it is impossible to go back.

Forgotten Rooms is a game that brings together psychological horror and survival elements that drag you into the unknown. As the line between reality and hallucination becomes thinner, you must face the darkness, loneliness and the beings that follow you to maintain your sanity while trying to find the exit.

Key Features:

* Fighting the Darkness: Your flashlight is your only friend, but you must use it wisely before its battery runs out.

Puzzles and Escape: Use your wits to open doors, discover secret passages and reach the exit.

Psychological Horror Elements: Real or imagined? How much can you trust what you see?

A Hotel Where Reality is Bent: As you progress, you will get lost in a hotel that looks familiar but is equally disturbing.

Is there an exit from here? Or will you discover something you won't want to leave?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: İntel i5 or AMD ryzon 5
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia gtx 1060 or amd radeon rx 580 or newer
  • DirectX: Version 12
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i9-14900K - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X3D
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 Ti - AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: RME Fireface UFX II

short_description: Forgotten Rooms is a game that combines psychological horror and survival elements. You are trapped in an abandoned, dark building and your only friend is your flashlight. As the line between reality and hallucination blurs, you must find the exit while maintaining your sanity.
